blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Established in response to the food crisis of the 1960s.
Formed based on the recommendations of the Foodgrains Policy Committee led by Ashok Mehta.
Created concurrently with the Agricultural Prices Commission, now known as CACP.
Serves as a crucial pillar for the Green Revolution by ensuring guaranteed procurement.

blocks.content: • Recommended by the Foodgrains Policy Committee headed by Ashok Mehta.

items: Ashok Mehta headed the Foodgrains Policy Committee that recommended this establishment.
Agricultural Prices Commission was renamed as the Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP).
Guaranteed procurement was introduced specifically to support the Green Revolution following the 1960s food crisis.

blocks.content: • Created alongside the Agricultural Prices Commission (now CACP).
• Supports the Green Revolution by guaranteeing procurement.
